approval_source: Current task conversation: user authorized direct remote code updates without further confirmation
approved_scope: upload the exact candidate backend source into a new managed immutable release
atomically update the single backend systemd drop-in to that release
restart the backend service and verify health and command-line release identity
build and atomically publish the frontend through the official locked entrypoint
verify the frontend release manifest, public URL, coordination metadata, and active hashes
explicit_exclusions: production database migration or schema mutation
Feishu, email, account, or other external-system writes
modification or cleanup of the dirty remote source checkout
claiming node-level SSOT ACCEPTED, device acceptance, or real-mail acceptance
preconditions: candidate source manifests and top-level candidate manifest pass hash verification
remote release identifiers are new and absent from managed roots
the official locked frontend entrypoint exists and is executable
the current backend listener is healthy before the switch
postconditions: active frontend and backend releases share the same release coordination identity
the release receipt records actual remote readback evidence
evidence_boundary: This receipt authorizes and records a code-only remote release. It does not change the SSOT node acceptance state or prove external, production-database, mail, Feishu, browser, or device acceptance.
